headline: DeepSeek's v4.1 Flash keeps its all-time token share record at 36.6%, now on day 2
summary: DeepSeek's v4.1 Flash is still sitting on the top spot and its all-time record, now in its second day of holding it. The provider overall takes 44.9% of tokens, and DeepSeek and Tencent together hold 55.0%.
highlights: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 holds the all-time token share record at 36.6%, now on day 2 of that streak.
DeepSeek as a provider sits at 44.9% of tokens, far ahead of everyone else on the board.
DeepSeek and Tencent together hold 55.0% of tokens, the top two providers.
typesafe's jev-1.13 climbed 10 places to rank 8, the biggest one-day move on the list.
New on the board: thinkingmachines inkling-2-small at rank 27, OpenAI gpt-6.2-astra at 42, and Liquid AI d1-ultra at 49.
Dropped off: StepFun step-5-preview (last at rank 14), Anthropic claude-sonnet-5 (last at 50), and thinkingmachines inkling-2-mini (last at 51).
